name: zotero-mcp-plus
description: Search, organize, cite, and analyze your Zotero library
long_description: MCP server for Zotero. REQUIRES the `uv` Python package manager (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) installed and on PATH — this extension launches the server via `uv run`. On macOS, GUI-launched apps may not inherit your shell PATH; if the extension fails to start, ensure `uv` is installed to a system-wide location (e.g. `/usr/local/bin` or via Homebrew) or that your launcher's PATH includes it. Needs ZOTERO_API_KEY and ZOTERO_USER_ID (zotero.org/settings/keys). OPENALEX_API_KEY (free, openalex.org/users/me) enables the knowledge-graph, citation-graph, and retraction tools.

user_id.title: Zotero User ID
user_id.description: Shown on the API keys page

openalex_api_key.title: OpenAlex API Key
openalex_api_key.description: Free key from openalex.org/users/me — required for knowledge graph and citation tools

semantic_scholar_api_key.title: Semantic Scholar API Key
semantic_scholar_api_key.description: Optional — improves rate limits for find_related_papers

polite_email.title: Contact Email (polite pool)
polite_email.description: Optional — your email for the OpenAlex/Unpaywall polite pool. Enables free full-text PDF lookup and better rate limits. Leave blank to disable.
